name: Yorkist Household Knights
headerMeta: Heroic era · Cavalry · unique kit (mounted/dismount) · 265 leadership · Seasonal
pitch: An all-around cavalry threat that trades well on flank and in duels whether mounted or dismounted, countering almost anything it meets. Its one real check is pikes on horse or a well-timed CC chaining into Stalwart on the ground.

veterancy.label: Full Top
veterancy.body: Good horse play and best-in-class dismounted gameplay; house card's mastery tree confirms full offense-line investment with the offense capstone taken.

battleRole.positioning: Cover Commander is the core playstyle: stay around the commander fully until they die. {1} When flanking, toggle Cover Commander ON beforehand and confirm the red glow — it grants strong defense for 15s, but X-move, spell V, or spell 1 cancels it. {1}
battleRole.tips: On horse: spell 1 = dismount (now rare, only vs anti-cav that can disrupt), spell 2 = charge, spell 3 = follow-commander charge; in a mounted 1v1, charge with spell 2 then dismount for a better success rate than Cover Commander alone. {1} On ground: don't hesitate to dismount and press spell 2 — keep the hero frontline but close to the unit, or it stops attacking and just runs; test engagement range in custom games. {1} Doctrine 5's per-attack scaling: +11% damage every 3rd attack, 15% max-health restore every 6th. {2}

matchups.pressure: You pressure: everything — Yorkist counters everything, the trade just depends on ground vs. horse.

controls.notes: Cover Commander toggle (red glow = active): stay with commander, grants a 15s defense buff, cancelled by X-move, spell V, or spell 1. {1} Spell 2 (charge) into dismount outperforms Cover Commander alone in a mounted 1v1. {1} Post-dismount spell 2 makes enemies rush you; don't cancel the buff by moving away. {1}
